mailboxes.description:
List of POP3/APOP mailbox definitions to access with pop3browser. Each item represents one server account configuration.

Note: For 'list' type, add an 'items' field defining the structure of list elements.
See 'items' below for field definitions.

head_patterns.description: List of header prefixes to include in the output of the 'show' command. Matches against the start of a header line.

body_lines.description: Number of body lines to display for each message when using the 'show' or 'mailbox' commands.
